digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 reconciler vendor adapter seam documentation
propositions: isinstance against @runtime_checkable Protocol returns false negatives on Python 3.12+ due to CPython gh-102433 switch to inspect.getattr_static which does not see __getattr__ attributes, causing dynamically-proxying transports to fail capability checks despite having the capability.

The prescribed isinstance-only guard in ADR-0083 is correct on Python 3.11 but silently skips writes on Python 3.12/3.13, creating a version-boundary safety hazard for rebar's supported interpreter range.

The sanctioned mitigation is isinstance primary check plus member-level hasattr fallback, with _capability_present as the reference implementation already applied in dispatch_apply_phases.py line 188.
Tree-wide sweep confirms all isinstance-against-Protocol sites and hasattr-based capability checks are already proxy-safe or correctly hardened; no source changes required.
ADR-0083 text at lines 193-197 requires amendment to document the 3.12+ limitation and prescribe the isinstance-plus-hasattr-fallback shape rather than isinstance-only.
The amendment was added to ADR-0083 matching the existing SupportsIncremental amendment style, citing getattr_static behavior and proxying transport consequences.
